notes.title: Case 02 is now live!
notes.content:
Case 02 is now live!

There is now an in-game map to move around while investigating the scene.
The screen for presenting evidence has been improved to show the question simultaneously.
Character visuals have ben updated. 
...and so on.

Many new features have been added to the game, so problems are expected.

I would be very grateful for any bug report m(_ _)m
(in fact a patch has been just released while I am writing this.)

In the next week I (I mean my friend) will be working on the unfinished localization which could not be done in time before the promised release date. There is also some unfinished business I have to deal with which should have been done before release.

In light of this, I think I will reserve more production time for Case 03 because I really want to make a good detective game.

Thank you so much for reading this! Enjoy٩(ˊᗜˋ*)و

notes.title: 【Bug Fix】Unlocking Achievement
notes.content:
We have fixed a bug regarding the the problem to unlock achievements.
Achievements which should have been unlocked already, were not reflected on Steam.

After updating to version 1.1.3, simply starting the game will make everything in sync.  
Players who have already unlocked the achievements should see the pop-up at the top-left corner on the main screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41654957/99208742ccf11986c9cc9cce147de48fa886cd19.png[/img]
(The pop up will just be a generic one, if no achievements had been unlocked prior to the update.)

We would also like to take this opportunity to thank our amazing player [i][u]@KnightAvenger[/u] [/i]who reported this bug (^^)

notes.title: Tokyo Detectives is now live!
notes.content:
Tokyo Detectives is now live with the first case [i]Murder in Akihabara[/i].

The gameplay is similar to Danganronpa and Ace Attorney.
[list][*]Witness questioning[/list]
[list][*]Murder scene investigation[/list]
[list][*]Interrogation of suspects[/list]
[list][*]Rebuttal section[/list]

Play as a homicide detective in Tokyo and investigate murder cases.
